metadata.title: CIVITA Reinforcement Material Types
metadata.description: Controlled vocabulary defining reinforcement material classifications for the CIVITA Experimental Database.

entries.definition: A polymer matrix composite reinforced with basalt fibers.
Uncoated reinforcement made of carbon steel or low-alloy steel.
A polymer matrix composite reinforced with carbon fibers.
Steel reinforcement with a protective zinc coating.
A polymer matrix composite reinforced with glass fibers.
Reinforcement made from a stainless steel alloy whose chromium content promotes the formation of a corrosion-resistant passive layer.
A reinforcement material outside the listed classifications.
